evidence.text: Can freezing and restoration of charged-state Krylov spreading provide a quantum-information diagnostic of extremal black-hole discharge associated with the Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC)?

evidence.text: Does third-order backreaction protect near-extremal GMGHS black holes against overcharging despite their finite-temperature extremal limit, and can an SDC tower provide dynamical discharge while relaxing the thermodynamic WGC bound?

sources.title: Transplanckian Censorship and the Local Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an electric black hole sustain a large but finite exterior dilaton excursion while retaining low curvature and slow discharge? The family separates the near-extremality parameter controlling the excursion from the mass scale controlling size and temperature.

sources.title: Massive Dirac particles on the background of charged de-Sitter black hole manifolds

evidence.text: Do massive charged Dirac fields admit self-adjoint dynamics, bound states or normalizable time-periodic solutions on charged de Sitter black holes, including degenerate horizons? Can continuum level crossing diagnose discharge, and what transmission estimates follow?

sources.title: The Swampland Conjectures: A Bridge from Quantum Gravity to Particle Physics

evidence.text: Can all allowed charged de Sitter black holes discharge while retaining a physically acceptable endpoint consistent with the thermal static-patch picture?

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: How does charged-black-hole evaporation change when positive vacuum energy introduces a cosmological horizon and a maximum black-hole mass at fixed charge?

sources.title: Primordial Extremal Black Holes as Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can primordial black holes below the ordinary evaporation-survival mass constitute dark matter through dark-charge near-extremality, and can their mergers produce observable Hawking-radiation transients or constrain a dark-sector weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Thermodynamics of near extreme black holes

evidence.text: How do ground-state degeneracy and the spacing of excited levels determine nearly extreme charged-black-hole thermodynamics, and could late-time radiation distinguish the proposed spectra?

sources.title: Swampland Statistics for Black Holes

evidence.text: Can a Pauli-inspired statistical instability model reproduce WGC-like charge-to-mass constraints, provide a black-hole mass cutoff, suppress remnant production, and prevent charged black holes from reaching naked-singularity configurations?

sources.title: Immortality through the dark forces: Dark-charge primordial black holes as dark matter candidates

evidence.text: Can a dark U(1) charge suppress both Hawking evaporation and Schwinger discharge sufficiently for very light primordial black holes to survive longer than the Universe, and how does the survival threshold depend on the lightest dark charged particle's mass and charge?

sources.title: Black holes coupled to a massive dilaton

evidence.text: How does a dilaton mass change charged black holes across the dilaton Compton scale, especially their horizons, extremal limits, string-metric throats, long-distance forces, and possible quantum fragmentation?

sources.title: Vaidya-Reissner-Nordström Extension On the White-hole Region

evidence.text: Can outgoing null radiation and electric discharge be incorporated into a charged white-hole model, and what would the resulting mass loss imply for horizons, endpoints and cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Generalizing weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: What charge-to-mass condition must an emitted charged shell satisfy for a nonextremal Reissner-Nordström black hole to evolve without increasing its charge-to-mass ratio, and how does this connect black-hole states to the available charged particle spectrum?

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: How do Hawking radiation and Schwinger production change charged black-hole mass and charge in de Sitter, and what EFT constraints follow if these configurations must return to empty de Sitter?

sources.title: Formulating the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS space

evidence.text: What particle-spectrum condition permits extremal RN–AdS black holes to emit charged particles, and can agreement between Schwinger production, near-horizon scalar instability, and particle repulsion motivate an AdS weak gravity conjecture?
